description: Server + Redux test coverage — fill critical gaps across auth, controllers, slices, and middleware

userStories.title: Server auth middleware tests
userStories.description: Add tests for server/src/middleware/auth.js — covers authenticate() and optionalAuth() functions. Test valid JWT, expired JWT, missing token, cookie-based vs header-based auth, and req.userId assignment.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests: valid JWT sets req.userId, expired JWT returns 401, missing token returns 401, optionalAuth passes without token, cookie auth preferred over header
userStories.notes: Mock jsonwebtoken. Auth file is 64 lines, straightforward middleware.

userStories.title: Server CSRF middleware tests
userStories.description: Add tests for server/src/middleware/csrf.js — covers generateCsrfToken() and validateCsrfToken(). Test token generation, validation success, validation failure, timing-safe comparison, and GET/HEAD bypass.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests: token generated and set in cookie, valid token passes, invalid token returns 403, GET requests skip validation, timing-safe comparison used
userStories.notes: Mock crypto. CSRF file is 80 lines.

userStories.title: Server error handler middleware tests
userStories.description: Add tests for server/src/middleware/errorHandler.js — covers errorHandler() and notFoundHandler(). Test error conversion to AppError, different status codes, dev vs prod stack trace exposure, and 404 handling.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests: generic error becomes 500, AppError preserves status, stack trace shown in dev, stack trace hidden in prod, notFoundHandler returns 404
userStories.notes: Error handler is 65 lines. Mock req/res/next.

userStories.title: Server request validation middleware tests
userStories.description: Add tests for server/src/middleware/validate.js — Zod schema validation factory. Test body validation pass, body validation fail with error details, query param validation, and params validation.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests: valid body passes, invalid body returns 400 with Zod errors, query validation works, params validation works, multiple field errors aggregated
userStories.notes: Validate.js is 34 lines. Use real Zod schemas in tests.

userStories.title: Server game controller tests
userStories.description: Add tests for server/src/controllers/gameController.js — covers saveGame() and loadGame(). Test save with version conflict detection, successful save, load existing state, load empty state, and syncVersion bumping.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests: save creates game state, save detects version conflict, save bumps syncVersion, load returns existing state, load returns empty for new user
userStories.notes: Game controller is 256 lines. Mock User model.

userStories.title: Server auth controller tests
userStories.description: Add tests for server/src/controllers/authController.js — covers register(), login(), logout(). Test successful registration, duplicate email, login with correct/wrong password, JWT cookie setting, and logout cookie clearing.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests: register creates user + sets cookies, duplicate email returns 409, login success sets JWT cookie, login wrong password returns 401, logout clears cookies
userStories.notes: Auth controller is 187 lines. Mock User model and bcrypt.

userStories.title: Server shop controller tests
userStories.description: Add tests for server/src/controllers/shopController.js — covers purchaseItem(). Test successful purchase, insufficient currency, item not found, inventory full, and currency deduction math.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests: purchase deducts currency + adds item, insufficient gold returns 400, invalid item returns 404, currency math is correct after purchase
userStories.notes: Shop controller is 72 lines. Mock User model.

userStories.title: craftingSlice tests
userStories.description: Add tests for src/store/slices/craftingSlice.js (347 lines). Test recipe unlock, ingredient management, crafting action outcomes, and crafting effects. This is the largest untested slice.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests: initial state correct, recipe unlocked, ingredient added/removed, crafting succeeds with valid ingredients, crafting fails with missing ingredients, crafting effects applied
12+ test cases covering all reducers and selectors
userStories.notes: Pure Redux slice — highly testable. Read existing slice test patterns in __tests__/ first.

userStories.title: inventorySlice tests
userStories.description: Add tests for src/store/slices/inventorySlice.js (318 lines). Test equipment slots, item add/remove, affixes, enchantments, item locking, and capacity checks.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests: initial state, add item, remove item, equip to slot, unequip, inventory capacity check, item locking, enchantment validation
userStories.notes: 318 lines. Watch for the capacity check at items.length >= 200.

userStories.title: journalSlice tests
userStories.description: Add tests for src/store/slices/journalSlice.js (344 lines). Test journal entry creation, quest notes, discovery tracking, pagination, and search/filtering.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests: initial state, add entry, add quest note, track discovery, entries sorted by date, search filters correctly

userStories.title: factionMiddleware tests
userStories.description: Add tests for src/store/middleware/factionMiddleware.js (206 lines). Test auto faction score adjustment on quest completion, purchases, dialogue, tier threshold crossing, and vocabulary rewards.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests: quest completion adjusts faction score, purchase adjusts score, tier threshold crossed dispatches event, vocabulary reward granted at tier up, score clamped to valid range
userStories.notes: Largest middleware at 206 lines. Follow existing middleware test patterns.

userStories.title: magicSlice tests
userStories.description: Add tests for src/store/slices/magicSlice.js (274 lines). Test root magic spells, element types, spell learning, spell validation, and element logic.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests: initial state, learn spell, spell already learned, element type assignment, root use recorded, spell validation passes/fails
userStories.notes: 274 lines. Note: 'form' destructured but unused in recordRootUse — don't fix, just test what exists.
